records.statement: AutoCalls is the primary AI communications runtime. HighLevel is optional as a CRM/integration and historical HighLevel Voice AI material is not runtime authority.
Internal template/persona names remain internal. Installed agents use customer-selected names and titles; demo-role disclosure is limited to the approved demo boundary.
Read authoritative CRM, D1, and handoff context before questioning; do not re-ask populated facts, and accept live corrections over stale context.

When conditions support discovery, connect multiple hot buttons/issues to underlying issues, current emotion, desired future state, future-state emotion, solution value, and an open-ended benefit-forward trial close. Do not trial close from one isolated issue.
Do not slow explicit high-intent buying action with unnecessary discovery. Stop probing on frustration, clear refusal, human request, opt-out, direct action, or another configured terminal condition.

Kelly is the website front-end role and Matt is the deeper transferred sales role. Matt is not the direct-inbound entry point for the intended SmartSite flow. Kelly continues closing when no transfer occurs.
Simulated visitor discoveries and actual prospect/business-owner discoveries are separate subjects with separate provenance and relationships.
AI SmartSite Base is $197 per month and Pro is $297 per month. Do not claim included or unlimited AI minutes/conversations and do not proactively introduce minutes.
Products, services, offers, plans, promotions, AI employee types/instances, demos, niches, differentiators, and their sales knowledge use normalized related entities rather than mixed records.
Each paying production customer requires a dedicated Worker and dedicated D1 binding. Shared production D1 tenancy is prohibited.
Cloudflare runtime integrations use machine-to-machine service authentication through managed secrets and bindings. Interactive OAuth is not a runtime dependency.
